hints.title: Resource Pool Allocation Management
hints.text: Assigning, verifying, and recycling numbers from a fixed numeric capacity requires constant-time membership tracking and extraction.

hints.title: Available Set for Constant Queries
hints.text: A hash set or queue tracking unused numbers provides instant assignment via pop and idempotent recycling through insertion.

hints.title: Set-Based Directory Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize available = set(range(maxNumbers)). In get(): if empty return -1, else pop and return. In check(n): return n in available. In release(n): add n to available.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: All operations (get, check, release) execute in O(1) average time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning a linear array of booleans on get() degrades allocation time to O(N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A set of available slots delivers constant-time allocation and recycling.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Idempotent release and constant-time check operations.
